purpose: Held-out set for the single evaluation of router v2: items that no router has seen, answered by arms B and S with two draws each under the conditions of the prospective campaign (MC-93).

vi-multimodel-v1-vmlu-valid.rule: per VMLU category, in proportion to its size (largest remainder); inside a category the items with the lowest sha256(seed + tab + dataset:item) come first

bidlqa-val.rule: the items with the lowest sha256(seed + tab + dataset:item)

budget.campaign_cap_scope: per run: each phase keeps its own guard, started from the usage already recorded in its own output

rotations.1: first B draw answers, second B draw is the probe's second answer, first S draw on escalation
rotations.2: second B draw answers, first B draw is the probe's second answer, second S draw on escalation (replication)

analysis.tests: per family and rotation: exact two-sided McNemar of v2 against always-B and against always-S, Holm over the two; the confirmatory claim is the primary family and rotation
analysis.cost: mean reported total tokens per item, both probe answers included whenever the probe ran
analysis.reading_extras: token-F1 per policy; items whose correctness differs between v2 and a fixed policy are exported for an AI-assisted semantic review, reported as descriptive
